main:1.text: Opening within a wartorn part of India, Chloe Frazer is seen browsing the wares of a shop when she is interrupted by a little girl, Meenu, who haggles with her. As they talk, Chloe wonders if the shop is run by her, but Meenu replies that its her father's (a soldier) who volunteered to fight the rebels (Asav's insurgents).

main:2.text: Chloe successfully infiltrates the active warzone, currently under rebel control. She receives a picture on her phone from her contact (Nadine) of a red door, which is where she needs to go. As she traverses around, Chloe witnesses the harsh living conditions imposed on the citizens by the rebels.

main:3.text: Chloe and Nadine traverse about the rooftops on their way to Asav's building whilst also encountering more enemies on the way. When they arrive, the two rummage through all the artifacts collected by Asav over the years and eventually find what they're looking for, a disc. Chloe and Nadine are suddenly interrupted when Asav and his men burst in and he confronts them.

main:4.text: Following their chaotic escape from India's urban warzone, Chloe Frazer and Nadine Ross venture deep into the wilderness of the Western Ghats using a 4x4 utility jeep. Chloe is following the clues left by her father to locate the fabled Tusk of Ganesh, an ancient Hoysala artifact. However, they quickly discover that Asav’s heavily armed insurgent army has beaten them to the region.

main:5.text: The location of this puzzle is in the far north of the map. Jump across the pillars in the three rooms in the correct order to complete. The location of this puzzle is in the center of the map. To trigger the fountains, players need to interact with the switch in the center of the ruins. The fountains must then be deactivated within the time frame.

main:6.text:
Players must position the statues in the room to cast shadows on the wall that match the paintings. To set up the solution, stand facing the space in the wall between the two paintings. Number the levers from the immediate right, circling up and around the chamber counter-clockwise to the left. Flip the levers in the following order:
4, 1, 11, 4, 9, 7, 12, 3

main:8.text: Players will make their way to the top of the Shiva statue and turn the mechanism, triggering a beam of light that fires across the chasm. A large structure will also lower down about midway. Chloe can use this to grapple across.

main:9.text: Realizing that Asav was planning to sell the Tusk of Ganesh for what seemed like munitions, Chloe, Nadine, and Sam begin making their way through the countryside to a train yard in the hopes of intercepting the sale and taking back the Tusk. Sam explains that he tried to gather intel on the buyers, but could not due to how secretive Asav was about it. Along the way, they notice the same helicopter circling the area.

main:10.text: Chloe, Nadine, and Sam race towards the train and face opposition from Asav's insurgents on motorbikes along the way, but manage to hold them off until the jeep gets close enough alongside the train for Chloe and Nadine to jump on, leaving Sam to drive. On the train, Chloe asks about the bomb's location, and Nadine states that its near the engine room.
